story.body: You heard the cry and the turn, and you kept the pen off your knee. The Mayor's pew was full. Your king stayed in your head until you could leave the aisle.

participation.context: Named the sallow and the east wind.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.quote: Sprigs of sallow. They have put them in for palms.

story.body: You saw the sprigs and did not take one. You left the door with the king still unwritten.

story.body: You let the printed line stand. You did not write a palm under it.

title: Read Palm Sunday, cold, in the almanac
